_comment: Where a weapon sits in a hand. Data, not code, for the same reason the HUD
layout is: getting a sword to look held is a dozen small nudges, and a dozen
small nudges through an edit-compile-launch loop is an afternoon.
Run `godot --path . --script tools/weapon_fit.gd` to render a contact sheet of
the captain holding whatever is in here, across the poses that matter. Nudge a
number, run it again. No game build in the loop.
bone      the skeleton bone it hangs off
bone      the skeleton bone it hangs off
length    how long the weapon reads IN THE WORLD, metres. She is 1.8 m.
offset    metres, in bone space directions, applied before rotation
rotation  degrees, XYZ, applied in that order
Meshy returns blades along the mesh's own Y. A hand holds a blade along roughly
the forearm axis, so every one of these carries a large rotation.
